builds.goal: Reference for Naafiri: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A pack-assisted AD skirmisher who lands paired daggers, preserves packmates with repositioning, and pursues a takedown reset. Do not award every pet hit as a full independent item proc; health-heavy routes need repeated contact to repay lost pick damage. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.

testPlan: Kit question for Naafiri: Track packmate availability and actual leap/bleed sequence. Do not award every pet hit as a full independent item proc; health-heavy routes need repeated contact to repay lost pick damage.

kitEvidence.formula:
Naafiri creates a Packmate every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds that will Attack enemies that she targets for [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 20; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, increased to [(characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 20; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (1.3)] after she uses an Ability. 

Hitting champions and large monsters with Abilities reduces this Ability's Cooldown by [4] seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by [1] seconds.

Max Packmates: [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])]

Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalDamageFirstCast@ physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalBleedDamage@ physical damage over @spell.NaafiriQ:BleedDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMinDamageSecondCast@ and @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMaxDamageSecondCast@ physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalHealSecondCast@ Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for @spell.NaafiriP:PackmateTauntDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing [125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing [(125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.1)] physical damage per Packmate.

If Naafiri scores a Takedown within [7] seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants [100 / 150 / 200 + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [3] seconds.

Naafiri becomes Untargetable for [1] second and prepares to hunt, spawning [2] additional Packmates and gaining [(0.2) × AD] Attack Damage and [(0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed for [5] seconds.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

Naafiri surges forward, dealing [15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.
